# Diagnose proof admission and counter failures

## Context
Load proof-accounting context. Start with [`proof_admit()`](mex://function:d5f2d4c6d20590d8fee9dc31a1b33fb2), then [`proof_budget()`](mex://function:8bb03e0dafe7429342393c57fd98549a) and [`proof_validate()`](mex://function:bd73ea15925ff921bc2eac449f4825d2). Sources: `scripts/nightshift-retry-budget.py` (line 202), `scripts/nightshift-retry-budget.py` (line 139), `scripts/nightshift-retry-budget.py` (line 154).

## Steps
1. Identify whether the error concerns schema/counters, changed pinned policy, pending work, or exhausted allowance. Sources: `scripts/nightshift-retry-budget.py` (line 148), `scripts/nightshift-retry-budget.py` (line 159), `scripts/nightshift-retry-budget.py` (line 204).
2. Reconcile attempts against development/final reservations and launches; count unknown outcomes as infrastructure failures. Source: `scripts/nightshift-retry-budget.py` (line 183).
3. Inspect pending attempt evidence before retrying; admission rejects any pending outcome. Source: `scripts/nightshift-retry-budget.py` (line 204).
4. Preserve the pinned policy and evidence; fix the producing path rather than manually clearing counters. Source: invariants in `scripts/nightshift-retry-budget.py` (line 147), `scripts/nightshift-retry-budget.py` (line 198).

## Gotchas
A probe contributes no reservation but still contributes an unknown infrastructure outcome. Proof policy permits 0–64 repairs and 0–2 infrastructure failures; the stored repair count must not exceed the pinned policy. Generic stage repair defaults are separate from proof limits. Sources: `scripts/nightshift-retry-budget.py` (lines 162–174 and 190), `scripts/nightshift-setup.py` (line 38).

## Verify
- [ ] Recomputed counters match stored counters. Source: `scripts/nightshift-retry-budget.py` (line 198).
- [ ] Pending and exhausted fixtures remain rejected; below-budget fixtures admit. Source: `scripts/nightshift-retry-budget.py` (line 202).
- [ ] [TO DETERMINE] exact dedicated proof test command: resolve its test caller through the graph before implementation.

## Debug
If admission still fails, compare policy identity and exact record keys before investigating provider execution. Sources: `scripts/nightshift-retry-budget.py` (line 147), `scripts/nightshift-retry-budget.py` (line 158).

## Update Scaffold
- [ ] Update `.mex/ROUTER.md` if project state changed.
- [ ] Update affected `.mex/context/` files and grounding after behavior changes.
- [ ] Update `.mex/patterns/INDEX.md` when adding a task pattern.

## Repeated registered artifacts

If the dashboard shows a repair-admission blocker, inspect the prior attempt and registered artifact. Formatting or renaming the finding is not a correction. Preserve counters; correct the relevant content or contract, then rerun the bounded dispatcher. Provider-switch guidance remains manual. Source: `docs/RETRY-BUDGETS.md`, `scripts/nightshift-retry-budget.py` (`repair_admission`).

## Console recovery resumes

Inspect the checkpoint before launching another diagnosis. Completed steps are
reused only while inputs and retained receipts match. Changed inputs invalidate
results without clearing attempts or extending the deadline. Configuration must
resolve before any console attempt is charged. Sources:
`scripts/nightshift-recovery-state.py`, `tests/test-recovery-state.py`.
